description:
Rack Card Printing: Design Eye-Catching and Informative Cards

Your customers need fast and direct information, which makes rack cards an exceptional marketing material displayed in high-traffic areas like hotel lobbies, waiting rooms, and retail stores. Our rack cards are printed on sturdy cardstock with compact design and vertical orientation, making them perfect for printing menus, promotional materials, and information cards.

Go-To Size and Paper Choices for Rack Cards

Looking for a sleek and effective format? This popular size and cardstock combo gives your rack cards a premium feel in a compact design that grabs attention.


Two Compact Sizes

Choose from 3.5" x 8.5" or 4" x 9", both designed to deliver clear, focused messaging. These sizes are perfect for brochure racks, countertops, and direct handouts, helping your content stay sharp and memorable.

14 pt. Cardstock - Most Popular Paper Type

This thick and durable cardstock offers a high-quality look and feel. Gloss finish brings out vibrant colors, Matte provides a smooth, glare-free appearance, and High Gloss UV adds extra shine and protection.

Additional Customization Options for Your Rack Cards

Add functional features and flexible options to make your rack cards work even harder for your business.



Perforation for Tear-Off Sections

Include a perforated section at the bottom of your rack card for easy tear-off. Use it as a coupon, business card, raffle ticket, or appointment reminder that customers can detach and take with them.

Front and Back Printing

Choose to print on one side for a simple, focused message or both sides to maximize space to share images, details, or contact information.

Writable Surfaces

For writing flexibility, choose Gloss Front with Uncoated Back if you're using 14 pt. cardstock. This gives you a shiny, eye-catching front and a writable back. If you need both sides to be writable, go with the fully Uncoated option, available in both 14 pt. and 17 pt. paper types.

Flexible Order Quantities

Order just what you need with quantities starting at 25 and going all the way up to 100,000. Perfect for both short runs and large-scale promotions.


Rack Card Printing FAQs

Q: What are the standard sizes of rack cards?

Rack cards are available in two size options: 3.5” x 8.5” and 4” x 9”.

Q: What are the differences between the cardstock options for rack cards?

We offer a range of cardstock options to match the look, feel, and function you need for your rack cards.

10 pt. Cardstock
This lightweight cardstock is stronger than regular paper. The Gloss finish makes colors brighter. The Matte version cuts down glare for easier reading. The High Gloss UV adds extra shine and protects against scratches.

14 pt. Cardstock
Thicker and sturdier than 10 pt., 14 pt. cardstock feels more premium. The Gloss finish makes colors pop. The Matte version gives a smooth, easy-to-read look. The High Gloss UV adds extra shine and protection. Choose Gloss Front, Uncoated Back for a shiny front and a writable back. The Uncoated version is fully writable on both sides. 

16 pt. Cardstock
Our 16 pt. cardstock is extra thick for a premium feel. The Gloss finish makes colors look bold and bright. The Matte version creates a smooth, elegant look that's easy to read.

17 pt. Cardstock
The thickest option we offer, 17 pt. cardstock is tough and premium. The Uncoated surface makes it easy to write on with any pen or pencil.

Q: How do I choose the ideal finish for my custom rack cards?

Gloss and high gloss laminations are an excellent choice if you want colors to appear more vibrant, while cardstock options with a matte or uncoated finish are a good option if readability is your priority.

Q: What is the thickest cardstock option for rack card printing?

The thickest option is the 17 pt. cardstock uncoated.

Q: How do I start designing a custom rack card?

Use our free downloadable templates to design your rack cards. Select the Templates tab on the rack cards product page, choose your preferred file type, and begin the design process.

Q: What file formats do you accept?

We accept the following formats: PDF, AI, EPS, CDR, TIFF, JPEG, PSD, INDD, and PUB files.

Q: Can I upload my file for review before I place my order?

Absolutely! We can check your files for errors and email you a link to the press-ready PDF proof, which you will see under Your Account. When you’re ready to place an order, simply approve the proof and proceed to checkout.

Q: When can I receive my rack cards?

The turnaround time for rack card printing is 2-6 business days. This doesn’t include shipping time, weekends, and holidays.

Q: Can I save more with bulk printing?

Absolutely yes! The bigger your quantity order, the lower the per-piece price you enjoy. You can find the cost of each rack card at the bottom of the online calculator, under the Printing Cost.

Q: How should I set up my rack card file to print at the correct size?

Using our rack card templates and keeping important content within the safe zone helps ensure accurate sizing.

Q: Does choosing gloss or matte change how thick my rack cards feel?

No. Paper thickness depends on the cardstock weight (like 10pt, 14pt, or 16pt), not the finish. Gloss and matte only change the appearance, not the durability.
